title: Evaluation of a new method CT-like imaging from an MRI examination
summary: Using a new sequence (T1 GRE), CT-like images will be investigated in the study for various clinical questions. Patients will be included, who receive a CT/MRI combination examination in the course of clinical routine. Afterwards, the results of the CT-like MRI sequence will be compared with the actual CT examination.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Clinical indication for MR examination; the indication must be indepentent of the study. Signed declaration of consent.
Exclusion criteria:
Missing consent and/or missing ability to consent to the study. 
Contraindications against an MRI examination, especially not MRI- suitable implants, tattoos or piercings, claustrophobia.
